description: This PHP source file provides utility functions for handling XML data, including loading XML from files, exporting data to XML format, and parsing simple XML objects into PHP arrays. It also discusses security considerations related to XML External Entity (XXE) attacks.

methods.name: simplexml_load_file_wrapper
methods.description: Loads an XML file, disables external entity loading for security, and handles errors if XML is not well-formed.

methods.name: exportDataToXML
methods.description: Exports a collection of items to an XML string, optionally including an XML header and wrapping in a root template.

methods.name: getItemsFromSimpleXMLObj
methods.description: Parses a list of SimpleXML objects into a PHP array according to specified element and attribute structures.
